name: samsad-adb-controller
description: Monorepo root for ADB Controller: shared core, MCP server, and the VS Code extension.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @samsadch/adb-core && npm run build -w @samsadch/adb-mcp && npm run build -w adb-controller-by-samsad
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @samsadch/adb-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @samsadch/adb-core && npm run test -w @samsadch/adb-core
